diagnostics.PLKA6008: branch evidence is incomplete or digest-invalid
diagnostics.PLKA6009: repair preview no longer matches current corrupt state
diagnostics.PLKA6010: more than one equally authoritative verified branch remains
diagnostics.PLKA6011: re-onboarding baseline proposal was not created

branch_evidence.collection: Read bounded generation/root/object files without following symlinks; hash exact bytes; validate 0.6.1 schemas/digests/references; traverse predecessor transitions backwards in sequence-descending then digest-ascending order; record every accepted/rejected branch and reason.
branch_evidence.verified: A branch root and every reachable member validates; transition sequences are contiguous; it descends from the last terminal receipt root or empty genesis; its canonical_model_digest equals the current canonical YAML digest; it contains no active commit_claimed.
branch_evidence.selection: Select greatest generation sequence. At that sequence select only a branch whose terminal receipt is uniquely digest-bound. If zero, PLKA6007. If more than one, PLKA6010; never choose lexicographically merely to hide a fork.

repair.preview: lore knowledge repair --preview emits projectlore-repair-preview/0.6.1 containing corrupt root bytes digest, selected prior root, sorted branch evidence and exact root action; preview_digest uses projectlore:repair-preview:0.6.1 excluding preview_digest/created_at.
repair.apply: lore knowledge repair --apply --preview-digest DIGEST acquires workflow lock, rehashes corrupt root and all selected evidence, stages+flushes a new recovery generation referencing selected root, atomically replaces workflow root, flushes directory, writes lifecycle receipt. Any mismatch PLKA6009 and zero visible effect.
repair.canonical: No canonical writer is invoked; before/after canonical and ordered three-query suite digests must match.

no_verified_branch.refusal: Repair preview contains conflict PLKA6007, entries=[], applicable=false; --apply refuses and writes nothing.
no_verified_branch.alternative: lore remove previews deletion of disposable acquisition state only. After digest-bound apply proves canonical/query equality, lore onboard start creates a new provenance baseline proposal. Readiness remains false until proposal review/apply and all receipts succeed; PLKA6011 if absent.
no_verified_branch.prohibition: Removal/re-onboarding never presents old proposal evidence as migrated or accepted.

fixtures.result: repair atomic root activation; lifecycle query equality true
disposable state absent; canonical/query suite unchanged; one new baseline proposal; readiness false
